purpose: Define Event as an explicit inert occurrence record with stable event identity, type, source, time and payload/provenance refs.

topics.name: Event Identity
topics.purpose: Define Event as an explicit inert occurrence record with stable event identity, type, source, time and payload/provenance refs.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant Event has an explicit event identity.
semantics.source_rule: Event source identity is exact and separate from Event identity.
semantics.time_rule: Occurrence time/run ordering metadata is explicit where machine-significant.
semantics.authority_rule: Event existence/content never grants execution authority.
semantics.immutability_rule: Past Event evidence is append/history governed and not silently rewritten.
semantics.correlation_rule: Correlation/causation refs are explicit and separate from identity.

invariants.rule: Event, Trigger, Runner and resulting Event are separate explicit identities connected only by declared causality edges; matching or adjacency never implies execution.

hard_gates.condition: event inferred only from log text
